interface.caller_contract: Parent binds actual filename/task/session/validation at owned settlement. Never bind a stale render to new callback/owner via mutable latest refs. Callback changes/equivalent rerenders do not create a fresh expiry allowance. Parent controls operation results; component does not mutate inputs or own HTTP.

acceptance: Use only own model-map entries and own typed fields. visible===false hides; omitted visible does not. Preserve raw map key/rawModelId, accessible raw/friendly label toggle, AG public/available/compatible grouping and stable sorting; GCLI has no fabricated AG catalog metadata.

Explicit click uses own nonempty testModel exactly. Older GCLI missing testModel may use actual nonempty raw map key; malformed present target and missing AG target disable safely. No generated alias, automatic call, retry or optimistic result.

Remaining finite0..1, zero/one known, malformed/missing unknown; explicit false quotaInfoPresent/remainingPresent/remainingValid wins. Remaining meter, unknown neutral empty track without aria-valuenow=0; preserve tiny-positive/near-one distinctions. resetTimeRaw strict real calendar/zone/Date range; resetTime display-only. rolling168h means unknown recovery, not a weekly countdown.

At most one local timer only for visible valid future nonrolling deadlines, clean up on unmount/invalid lifetime/no future deadline. Guard clicks and timer delivery with captured mounted lifetime, !busy, scope.mode===mode and isCurrent. Expiry does not imply recovery; optional saved-readback once per actual owner/deadline, coalesce cards, consume before callback, no retry after rejection. Busy may defer once while same owner remains; invalid lifetime discards.

Preserve warm-gray card/ARIA style. Known remaining >=70% green #10b981, >=30% #e0aa14, lower #c65746; 6px meter, 14px radius and 15/16px spacing. Keep existing independent real 5H/week summary outside component. No raw errors, credentials, logs, persistence, quota/test/release/Preview HTTP imports.

Page display is primarily accepted by a human under TEST_POLICY.md. Add only the minimum critical regression for the explicit real target/current owner and stale captured callbacks/timers not acting on a new owner. Do not build display/DOM/style/snapshot or lifecycle cross-product suites, duplicate existing lower-layer coverage, mock ownership to self-prove it, or lower assertions. Functional requirements above remain unchanged.

interface.receipt: Readonly<{ source: 'response' | 'saved'; filename: string; scope: Readonly<PanelScope>; validation: SessionValidationSnapshot; result: ManualResult }>

interface.caller_contract: Receipt object and validation reference are stable immutable identities from the actual owned settlement. Caller does not reconstruct or restamp stale/saved evidence with fresh scope/time. Saved evidence remains display-only. onRefresh requests only current-owner saved status/list readback, never manual quota/release/test.
interface.real_core: getSessionSnapshot/getSessionValidationSnapshot/subscribeSession/subscribeSessionValidation; getPanelChannelSnapshot/isPanelScopeCurrent/subscribePanelChannel. capturePanelScope takes the actual current sessionEpoch. SessionValidationSnapshot has only sessionEpoch/status; identity must be retained, no invented token/validationEpoch field.

acceptance: AG only: GCLI renders no AG controls and sends no requests. Union two known groups with own valid returned quota_groups/quota_group_states keys; keep genuine additional canonical groups, not hardcoded two-only. Own typed projection before existing helpers; invalid/conflicting state=>abnormal/restricted, blocked_unknown=>recovery unknown, manual_override retains timed cooldown, missing=>unknown. Seconds must be finite/nonnegative/Date-valid; no unit guessing or expiry-based unblocking.

Display Opus5.5/4.6 state and valid checked_at/last_attempt_at/next_check_at/blocked_until independently. Fresh directory support requires checked_at<=now<checked_at+43200; unavailable never auto-recovers on timer. Missing/invalid/future evidence unknown. Known reasons generation_404/directory_missing/directory_query_failed/directory_timeout only; raw reason/error hidden. Successful current response with own valid models lacking claude-opus-5-5-(low|medium|high) keys may show5.5 catalog-missing, never fabricate4.6 rule.

Release eligibility requires same verified owner, filename, Scope3, exact captured validation identity; source=response, result.success, blockedUnknown&&!invalid. UI eligibility is not a server ticket. Saved/failed evidence, remaining fraction, expiry or applied writeback cannot confer permission. Real Core/session subscriptions revoke loss/reverify and session/channel ABA.

Stable receipt-identity/group single-use ticket; open/cancel zero calls. Capture confirmation actor/owner/target, recheck and consume synchronously before actual adapter call. Old confirm/cancel/A->B->A/rerender/remount handlers cannot revive retired tickets or consume new receipt. Minimal weak identity bookkeeping may preserve consumed/retired tickets across remount; no copied payload cache/storage. Cancel before dispatch leaves ticket unconsumed but retires confirmation actor.

Abort/retire old work on owner/validation/receipt/target loss, disable or unmount. Late completion/catch/finally cannot change fresh UI/focus/onRefresh. Sent ticket stays consumed on failure/unknown, no retry. Validate safe adapter output; release only removes abnormal blocking, never claims quota replenishment/clears model_cooldowns/other groups. Keep generation verification, local writeback, directory and protection evidence separate.

Plain text, existing Button/Badge/AlertDialog accessibility/focus; no raw payload/error, real credentials, log/persistence, prop mutation, automatic test/quota/release/Preview/poll. Independent real5H/week quota summary remains outside component, never derived from model fractions/rolling168h/group state.
